select_sql:
tk.ad_user_id,
       pb.ten_phongban,
       vtr.ten_role,
       tk.ma_user,
       tk.hoten,
       tk.diachi,
       tk.email,
       tk.phone,
       tk.fax
from_sql:
ad_user tk
INNER JOIN
  (SELECT tk_vtr.ad_role_id,
          tk_vtr.ad_user_id,
          tk_vtr.md_phongban_id
   FROM ad_user_role tk_vtr
   WHERE tk_vtr.ad_role_id = '@id' ) AS tkvtr ON tkvtr.ad_user_id = tk.ad_user_id
LEFT JOIN ad_department pb ON tkvtr.md_phongban_id = pb.md_phongban_id
